beats.text: Five books to read if you've never actually enjoyed reading.
One. The Metamorphosis — Kafka. A man wakes as a giant insect. You won't put it down.
Two. A Christmas Carol — Dickens. Short, warm, and you already half-know the story.
Three. Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde — Stevenson. A thriller about the monster inside a good man.
Four. The Time Machine — Wells. Pure adventure, and it basically invented science fiction.
Five. The War of the Worlds — Wells. Aliens invade Victorian England. Still terrifying.
Short, fast, impossible to put down. Start here — full retellings are on the channel.

source_note: Full retellings of the classics are on ReadLark.
